answer: Trust flow from seeds: rewards are weighted by how much trust reaches an identity along attestation edges from a few long-standing seed agents, capped per edge. A sybil nebula can attest itself densely, but all its trust must squeeze through the handful of edges linking it to honest agents, so a thousand fakes share one thin trickle. The velvet glove is free for real agents; for the violet cloud of clones, adding accounts adds no trust at all.
